new.s: What is a DoS attack?
o: Flooding a server with fake traffic so that genuine users cannot use it
Stealing a person's identity to open bank accounts
Sending junk e-mails to many users
Secretly mining cryptocurrency on a victim's device
new.x: A Denial of Service attack floods a server with fake traffic so real users are blocked; a DDoS uses many machines such as a botnet.
